name: Marsden Farm NCCPI and CSR2 by soil map unit
scope: Union of 36 Iowa State Marsden Farm research plots in Boone County, Iowa. The study footprint is a field-scale example with its own published boundaries.

sql_queries.mapunits_and_polygons: SELECT m.mupolygonkey, m.mukey, m.mupolygongeo.STAsText() AS polygon_wkt, u.musym, u.muname, u.iacornsr AS iowa_csr2, u.farmlndcl, l.areasymbol, CONVERT(varchar(10), s.saverest, 23) AS survey_saved FROM SDA_Get_Mupolygonkey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('POLYGON ((-93.78624049641213 42.01286904925821, -93.78206238279688 42.01286904925821, -93.78206238279688 42.014543861566075, -93.78624049641213 42.014543861566075, -93.78624049641213 42.01286904925821))') AS k JOIN mupolygon AS m ON m.mupolygonkey = k.mupolygonkey JOIN mapunit AS u ON u.mukey = m.mukey JOIN legend AS l ON l.lkey = u.lkey LEFT JOIN sacatalog AS s ON s.areasymbol = l.areasymbol ORDER BY m.mukey, m.mupolygonkey
sql_queries.component_interpretations:
SELECT c.mukey, c.cokey, c.compname, c.compkind, c.majcompflag, c.comppct_r,
  i.rulekey, i.mrulename, i.ruledepth, i.interphr AS nccpi_v3_overall
FROM component AS c
LEFT JOIN cointerp AS i ON c.cokey = i.cokey
  AND i.rulekey = '54955' AND i.ruledepth = 0
WHERE c.mukey IN (2550308, 2765522, 2834849, 2835012, 2835146, 2922007)
ORDER BY c.mukey, c.cokey

method: Read the published plot geometries as WGS84 and transform them to NAD83 / Conus Albers (EPSG:5070). Union the 36 plots.

Project the USDA soil map polygons to the same CRS, intersect the footprint, and dissolve the intersections by map unit key. Verify the mapped union covers the footprint and that map units do not overlap at the reporting precision.

Use the top-level NCCPI version 3 overall rule 54955. For each map unit, weight interphr by comppct_r among major earthy components, using the eligible component percentages as the denominator. Confirm the eligible components have ratings before summarizing.
For each index, multiply each map-unit rating by its intersection acres and divide the sum by the rated acres. Preserve acreage without a rating as a separate value.
